openItems.explanation: Washington is not on the 2025 credit reduction list (California 1.2%, the U.S. Virgin Islands 4.5%), and every HANGS wage is a Washington wage, so line 11 is $0.00 and no Schedule A is attached. The Department of Labor names the 2026 credit reduction states in November 2026, after the November 10 repayment deadline. A person checks the 2026 list before signing; each 0.3% of credit reduction would add $2,121.00 on $707,000.00 of FUTA wages, due with a fourth-quarter deposit by February 1, 2027.

Tomas Arvelo, an individual, was paid $21,168.00 through accounts payable in Q3 for 504 hours of concrete finishing at $42.00 an hour, working under the HGC foreman at Tideflats Cold Storage, and the client plans to send a Form 1099-NEC. Whether he is an employee is a common-law question for a person; the IRS can also be asked on Form SS-8. If he is, he gets a Form W-2 instead, $7,000.00 of FUTA wages and $42.00 of tax join Q3 (line 16c), and line 3 grows by $21,168.00. The draft reports the payroll as recorded.

The Q1 FUTA deposit of $4,055.90 was due Thursday, April 30, 2026; the client's log shows it made Friday, May 1, 2026, 1 day late. The IRS may assess a 2% failure-to-deposit penalty, $81.12; a person decides whether to ask for relief if it does. Because not all FUTA tax was deposited when due, the return is due February 1, 2027, not February 10, 2027. Q2 and Q3 were carried forward correctly ($115.61 at September 30). The projected $186.10 undeposited at December 31 is $500 or less and may be paid with the return; a credit reduction (CREDIT-01) would put it over $500 and require a deposit by February 1, 2027.

The full 5.4% credit, with lines 9 and 10 at zero, assumes all 2026 Washington unemployment tax is paid by February 1, 2027. The Q2 ESD report as filed left out the June 26 bonus run ($55,500.00 of wages), the Q3 report was due November 2, 2026 and the Q4 report is due February 1, 2027. A person confirms the amended Q2 report and the Q3 and Q4 payments are made by then; state tax paid later limits the credit through the line 10 worksheet.

The fourth quarter is projected: October 2, 16 and 30 as paid; November 13 and 27, December 11 and December 24 at scheduled hours and current rates with no overtime; one planned hire, Ilse Brandvold from November 16. FUTA changes only for employees still under $7,000: Yusuf Quintero, Ilse Brandvold. Line 3, line 5 and line 16d ($70.49) are refreshed from the final December register in January before the return is signed.

rules.question: Must HANGS Construction Services file Form 940 for 2026?
rules.whyItMatters: FUTA applies to an employer that paid $1,500 or more of wages in any quarter, or had an employee in 20 or more weeks, in the current or the prior year.

rules.question: When is the 2026 Form 940 due?
rules.whyItMatters: Sets the filing deadline. A due date on a weekend moves to the next business day, and an employer that deposited all its FUTA tax when due gets ten more days.
rules.effective: Instructions for Form 940 (2025), the current instructions on November 7, 2026; the 2026 instructions are not yet published. The rule is the same each year: January 31 after the year.
rules.excerpt: The due date for filing Form 940 for 2025 is February 2, 2026. However, if you deposited all your FUTA tax when it was due, you may file Form 940 by February 10, 2026. ... If any due date for filing falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday, you may file your return on the next business day.

rules.question: What are the 2026 FUTA rate, wage base and credit?
rules.whyItMatters: The tax is 6.0% of the first $7,000 of each employee's wages for the year, less a credit of up to 5.4% for state unemployment tax paid, so 0.6% after the full credit.
rules.excerpt: For 2026, the FUTA tax rate is 6.0%. The tax applies to the first $7,000 you pay to each employee as wages during the year. ... The credit may be as much as 5.4% of FUTA taxable wages. If you're entitled to the maximum 5.4% credit, the FUTA tax rate after credit is 0.6%.

if you're entitled to the maximum 5.4% credit, the futa tax rate after credit is 0.6%
rules.ruleOrLimit: 6.0% on the first $7,000 of each employee's wages for 2026; a credit of up to 5.4% for state unemployment tax; 0.6% after the full credit.
rules.hangsApplication: Line 7, $707,000.00 of FUTA taxable wages (101 employees, each reaching $7,000), x 0.6% = line 8, $4,242.00, on the full 5.4% credit.

changes.note: On November 7, 2026 the IRS's current Instructions for Form 940 and Schedule A are the 2025 editions. The 2026 rate, wage base and deposit rules are checked in Publication 15 (2026); the due date rule and the line instructions are the 2025 wording, which states the same rules each year.

The Department of Labor announces the 2026 credit reduction states in November 2026, after the November 10 deadline for states to repay their federal unemployment loans. Until then the 2025 list is the latest; CREDIT-01 stays open.
